title: Amorph
description: Six Beatles album covers printed in tens of thousands of dots of ink. Every few seconds the next cover weaves in like a loom: each row of dots slides along its own line, trailing a comet of ink, to the place in the next cover that matches its tone, cascading from top to bottom.
intent: A designed transition instead of random flight: dots keep their row and travel only sideways to the matching tone, so the change reads as a clean scanning pattern with motion trails.
